summary: Phase 54.15 Daily Team Performance Digest tested end-to-end. 9/9 backend pytest cases pass (auth-gated GET/POST endpoints, schema, regenerate, by-date, 404, 400, /recent). Frontend UI test passes: sidebar 'Daily Digest' link, /admin/daily-digest page loads, WhatsApp preview renders 1.4 KB message starting with '*Daily Performance' and contains all 5 required sections (TOP 3 OVERALL, TOP PER TEAM, IMPROVING, FALLING, WEEK-OVER-WEEK), Copy/Open-WhatsApp/Date-picker/Regenerate buttons all present and functional. Regenerate for 2026-05-11 (Mon) returned a populated digest (43 recruiters, 4 team leads, Bhumika Anand 15 pts top).

minor.issue: User rohit@vhc.in is role='admin' in DB but /app/memory/test_credentials.md labels them as 'Recruiter'. Either update the credentials doc or fix the DB row. Negative-auth recruiter test had to be switched to maneet@vhc.in (employer).

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning 'Encountered two children with the same key, Rakshita' — Badge uses key={n} (name). Duplicate recruiter names produce duplicate React keys. Use a composite key like `${n}-${i}` or include user_id.

action_items: Frontend: fix duplicate-name React key warning in DailyDigestPage inactive recruiters/employers Badge maps (use composite key with index or user_id).
Memory hygiene: reconcile test_credentials.md — rohit@vhc.in is admin in DB, not recruiter. Either downgrade the user or relabel the doc and add a real recruiter for negative-auth testing.
critical_code_review_comments: team_digest_service.py is ~700 lines — borderline; still cohesive (KPI weights, matrix builder, message formatter, persistence). Acceptable for now.

build_daily_digest performs 3 bulk Mongo aggregations for the 14-day window — good, avoids N×M query explosion. Reading 500 users + 200 employers + 200 teams unbounded; for larger orgs consider pagination/projection (already projects {_id:0} which is good).

/api/admin/daily-digest lazy-generates on first GET inside an HTTP handler (12 s observed). For a cold cache the dashboard could time out behind a CDN/ingress with shorter timeouts. Consider returning a 202 + 'building' status, or ensuring the scheduler primes today's cache on app startup.

format_whatsapp_message uses Markdown asterisks/underscores expected by WhatsApp; whatsapp_text is stored on every digest doc — works but duplicates ~1 KB of data per row; OK at one-per-day cardinality.
Date validation in routes/daily_digest.py only checks YYYY-MM-DD format; no upper bound check (future-dated regenerate will silently produce an empty digest). Optional hardening.

Frontend DailyDigestPage ISTToday() computes IST date using device timezone offset — correct for IST/Asia browsers but admins outside IST will see a 1-day skew on initial selectedDate. Consider deriving from digest.date on first load (already done after loadToday).

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed (43 recruiters, 4 team leads, 6 teams). Generated/persisted digest doc for 2026-05-11 in daily_team_digests collection via /regenerate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_daily_digest.py and can be re-run with `pytest backend/tests/test_daily_digest.py -v`. All 5 endpoints validated: GET /api/admin/daily-digest, GET /api/admin/daily-digest/recent?days=N, GET /api/admin/daily-digest/{YYYY-MM-DD}, POST /api/admin/daily-digest/regenerate, POST /api/admin/daily-digest/{YYYY-MM-DD}/regenerate. Auth gating verified (admin=200, no-token=403, employer=403). WhatsApp text schema markers locked in. Only open follow-up is the React duplicate-key console warning on inactive recruiters list with duplicate names.
rca of the issue: React duplicate key warning RCA: in DailyDigestPage.jsx the inactive_recruiters/employers map renders Badges with `key={n}` where n is the recruiter name string. The seed has two recruiters named 'Rakshita', so the resulting key array contains 'Rakshita' twice. Fix: change to `key={`${n}-${i}`}` or include user_id in the payload (currently inactive_recruiters is a plain list of names; could be promoted to [{user_id,name}] in team_digest_service.py — preferred long-term).
